title: Lorgan's Chest Key
summary: Opens the central chest in the Open Hand Temple dormitories.

fields.Acquisition: Take it from Father Lorgan’s body. A DC 15 Sleight of Hand check also opens the chest. DC 10 Investigation notices a false bottom containing Lorgan’s journal.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
